body.statement: For CauCA with known DAG, if every node has one perfect stochastic intervention satisfying the almost-everywhere interventional-discrepancy condition of Assumption 4.1, equality of the observational and interventional laws identifies the latent coordinates up to componentwise invertible transformations.

attestation.note: Checked against the primary paper at Assumption 4.1 and Theorem 4.2(ii); a stable primary-paper URL is supplied in place of a verbatim transcription.
